```plato

    // A list of degree-of-freedom contributions summed into a dense load vector.
    // Contributions may repeat a degree of freedom; they add, which is what lets
    // every load type below be resolved independently and simply concatenated.
    ScatterLoads(contributions: Array<DofLoad>, dofCount: Integer): Array<Number>
    {
        var loads = FilledNumbers(dofCount, 0.0);
        var k = 0;
        while (k < contributions.Count)
        {
            loads = contributions[k].Dof.Value.AddAt(loads, contributions[k].Amount);
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return loads.Freeze();
    }
```
